title: Sealbreaker fragment

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Sealbreaker fragments are resources obtained from Infested Mines in the Mistlands that are used to build the Sealbreaker.
Nine total fragments are required to build one Sealbreaker.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: • Infested Mines in Mistlands. Found in blue-lit glass displays throughout the mines.
